description.narrative: A risk sharing facility (RSF) covering a maximum portfolio of up to XOF10 billion (approximately US$16 million equivalent), where IFCs maximum exposure is up to 50% of the maximum portfolio, to be committed in two equal tranches. The proposed RSF is to support the Banks portfolio related to access to finance for healthcare SMEs (HSMEs) to acquire medical equipment in Côte dIvoire and Senegal and is proposed to be processed under the IFCs Africa Medical Equipment Facility (AMEF) program, which is supported by the IDA19 IFC-MIGA Private Sector Window Blended Finance Facility (the AMEF RSF Project).

The most significant expected project-level outcome is the increase in access to finance for HSMEs and the provision of medical equipment for diagnosis and treatment services. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the Project will promote resilience in the sector by increasing the capacity and the quality of delivery to fill the growing need for healthcare services.
